items.title: Nicki Parrott interviewed by Monk Rowe. Utica, New York, November 6, 2010 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: And my teacher was Rufus Reid at the time.

ctx.x: Son. And his mother, who passed away recently in Philadelphia. A wonderful piano player. But they kind of took me in and it was just really a beautiful experience. I think I did that for like a year even, just playing there a couple of times a week, and it was just like a way to get your feet wet. It was a fun gig you know, it was just for people having coffee before they went to the movie. I didn’t care you know what I mean? You just want to play and get out there. And then at night if I could afford it I’d go…
